summary.title: As the Culmination of 70 Years of Educational Reform
summary.description: From post-war democratic education to quantitative expansion during the high-growth period, qualitative transformation emphasizing individuality, and the current digital revolution. Learning from the issues of each era, AI Creator Lab realizes a next-generation educational model that combines scientific evidence and AI technology, building on this historical accumulation.
